**中文**：① **上手路径补两块**：quickstart 新增「宿主接入（一条命令，`install-hooks --auto` 自动探测并给唯一推荐命令）」与「多宿主/多会话并发（文件锁 / 按 gene_id 寻址 / LWW 台账三条机制）」——回应 0.29 评测 usability 扣分；② **「不适用场景」显式化**（docs/overview.md 新增表：跨机同写同库 / 要 100% 避坑 / 实时同步 / 一次性任务 / 把基因库当知识库 / 跨架构直接复用）；③ **溯源自动归因**（deposit/register-hit/negate 自动读 `~/.evomap/source.json` 记录模型与主机，不必改钩子、不必重启）；④ **异构验证实测**（`exp/heterogeneity-probe.mjs` 首次真跑：同一确定性 GBK 陷阱，deepseek-v4-flash **5/5 正确**、agnes-3.0-flash **0/5**，失败签名一致率 **0%** ⇒ 异构兜底真实存在）；⑤ **理论出处致谢**（arXiv:2512.05117 原文核对：其"共享子空间→继承共同失败模式"是**开放问题**，我们做的是响应级实测；媒体转述的"16 维=智能""98–99% 误差仍保功能"**原文不支持，本项目不引用**）；⑥ `docs/one-pager.md` 一页纸（判断要不要用，含信任要素与局限）并挂进导航；⑦ `gene-pull-trust` 池信任分布可见化；⑧ **两个平台的 GBK 陷阱数据修正**（≤0.28 误为 UTF-8，陷阱实际永不触发）。

 ① onboarding: quickstart gains "host integration in one command" (`install-hooks --auto` detects and prints the single recommended command) and "multi-host / multi-session concurrency" (file lock, gene_id addressing, LWW ledger) - answering the 0.29 usability deduction; ② explicit "not applicable" scenarios in docs/overview.md; ③ provenance auto-attribution (deposit/hit/negate read `~/.evomap/source.json` automatically - no hook edits, no restarts); ④ first real cross-model measurement (`exp/heterogeneity-probe.mjs`: same deterministic GBK trap - deepseek-v4-flash **5/5 correct**, agnes-3.0-flash **0/5**, failure-signature agreement **0%** => heterogeneous fallback is real); ⑤ theory attribution (arXiv:2512.05117, read at source: its "shared subspace -> shared failure modes" is an **open question**; the media's "16 dims = intelligence" / "98-99% error yet function preserved" are **not supported by the paper** and are not cited here); ⑥ one-pager for the adoption decision; ⑦ pool trust distribution; ⑧ corrected GBK trap data (shipped as UTF-8 in <=0.28, so the trap could never fire).

可持续性版 / Sustainability release (zero new features, debt repayment only): anti-pattern status annotations (all 14 catalog entries carry current/fixed markers + legend - historical pitfalls no longer read as live defects); cross-machine handbook (named pools, pull/push/contribute workflow, three-layer concurrency semantics, team-pool structure, troubleshooting); host compatibility matrix (8 hosts); Flow C operational handbook (command-level); deduplication (SKILL quick-list 6→3 rows); starter bundle 10→20 genes; full terminal output samples in quickstart. / 中文：反模式状态标注+跨机手册+宿主矩阵+Flow C 手册+去冗余+starter 扩容+输出样例。

可审计的生命周期与量化版 / Auditable lifecycle & quantification: auditable deposit events (draft/distill --commit writes deposits.jsonl); verification backfill (recall --record writes verifications.jsonl); report weekly quantification (L1 activity / L2 backfill / L3 error-family recurrence, --json); license issue/verify (Ed25519-signed tokens, issuer public key shipped, private key never packaged); named pool profiles (~/.evomap/pools.json) + push-ready hint in doctor; url-guard hook template (PreToolUse routes content pages through markitdown); three-layer concurrency semantics. / 中文：沉淀可审计+验证回填+效果量化周报+许可机制+命名池+就绪提示+url-guard+并发三层化。

零指导上手与基因分类版 / Zero-guidance onboarding & gene categorization: install guide rewritten (three acquisition paths, zero-npm declaration); official pool mirror URL documented (gene pull --pool https://zyx.pink/pool/genes.jsonl); gene categorization enabled (6-scene controlled vocabulary, pull --scene / list --scene); pool repo CC-BY-4.0 LICENSE + CONTRIBUTING.md; IO retry visibility; deployment & distribution section. / 中文：安装指引重写+镜像 URL 入文档+场景分类与拉取+池许可贡献条款+重试可见化+部署分发节。

可信度与可采用性版 / Credibility & adoptability: benchmark long-context baseline arm (--arm full-context); one-command host integration install <host> + 90s demo; gene pool workflow (pull / submit --bundle) + pool repo CC-BY-4.0 LICENSE + CONTRIBUTING.md; IO retry visibility (doctor + EVOX_IO_RETRY env + bad-line context with line numbers); SKILL.md deployment & distribution section. / 中文：基准三臂对照+一键宿主接入+90秒自演示+基因池工作流+池许可与贡献条款+重试可见化+部署与分发节。

外部实例版 / Adoption & promotion: feedback command (zero telemetry) + ADOPTERS.md + GitHub issue templates (adoption-report/feedback) + bilingual quickstart & one-pager + 0.21.0 eval fixes (param defaults/ledger warnings/best-practices entry) + shareable re-sign command + approve auto-evidence with ledger-source transparency + gate rejects AVOID-only half-products + safetyGate exported. / 中文：外部实例机制+推广材料+评测缺口修复+签名链修复+审核取证绑死+闸门加固+池重建补闸。

**pi-evox-loop v0.14.6**

- Added new self-check command: `node code/light-cli.mjs doctor` for quick environment, Node version, and directory checks with actionable repair hints.
- Updated documentation to guide new users through a 3-step initial setup, including running self-check and first experience entry.
- Enhanced first-run experience: provides clear instructions if recall returns "no fix available", and guides users to deposit their first fix.
- Several new and updated scripts and experiment files added to `_val/` and related directories.
- Internal code improvements and documentation clarifications in all main scripts and the SKILL.md.

- Added a concise "30 秒上手（Quick-Start）" section to SKILL.md for faster onboarding, highlighting core usage (A/B flows) with sample commands.
- Clarified key requirements and FAQs at the top, including guidance for first-run scenarios and Node.js version compatibility.
- Improved organization and brevity by moving full instructions, caveats, and extended documentation after the quick-start guide.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- No changes in core functionality; updates focus on documentation clarity and usability.

0.14.4 - guided deposit (light-cli draft --error), single-token anti_patterns so the conflict guard actually fires, recall load-balancing bias (FlyLoRA/Switch-style), per-host injection telemetry, last-write-wins audit semantics completed in 3 more readers, authoritative-only error flags in production distillation. Acknowledgements added for FlyLoRA / FlyHash / Switch Transformer.

0.14.3: quarantine now revokes approval (ledger last-write-wins); narration guard blocks session-trace text from injection; distill_sessions upgraded to a real distillation adapter (arg-diff extraction + two-tier gate + candidate report); content-level dedup in light-cli distill; query-targeted top-N recall.
